title: Occidental Mindoro lifts ban on entry of live pigs for slaughter

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The provincial government of Occidental Mindoro has lifted its temporary ban on the entry of live pigs from provinces that were designated animal disease risk zones, while maintaining strict controls on incoming pork and pork products. Gov. Eduardo B. Gadiano signed Executive Order No. 75, series of 2026, on Oct. 27, lifting the restrictions imposed under Executive Order No. 63-B, series of 2026. READ: Occidental Mindoro bans live hog entry amid swine fever case According to the Office of the Provincial Veterinarian, the new order allows the entry of live pigs meant for the abbatoir.
